in.definition: Inside a place or enclosed area.
in.exampleUsage: The notebook is in the drawer.

on.definition: Touching and supported by the surface of something.
on.exampleUsage: The pen is on the desk.

under.definition: Below something else, often covered or sheltered by it.
under.exampleUsage: The bag is under the chair.

behind.definition: In or to or toward the rear.
behind.exampleUsage: The printer is behind the chair.

in-front-of.definition: In a position that is ahead of or facing the front side of something.
in-front-of.exampleUsage: The table is in front of the window.

next-to.definition: Immediately beside or very close to something or someone.
next-to.exampleUsage: The bin is next to the door.

between.definition: In the space separating two people or things.
between.exampleUsage: The chair is between two desks.

above.definition: At a higher position than someone or something.
above.exampleUsage: The clock is above the noticeboard.

below.definition: At a lower position than someone or something.
below.exampleUsage: The box is below the noticeboard.

inside.definition: In the enclosed space of a place or container.
inside.exampleUsage: The shoes are inside the cupboard.

outside.definition: Not within a place or container.
outside.exampleUsage: The bicycle is outside the flat.

beside.definition: Shows that one thing is next to or very near another thing.
beside.exampleUsage: The bag is beside the cupboard.

near.definition: At a short distance from someone or something.
near.exampleUsage: The desk is near the door.

far.definition: At a great distance from a person or place.
far.exampleUsage: The second desk is far from the door.

opposite.definition: On the other side, facing someone or something.
opposite.exampleUsage: The chair is opposite the window.

against.definition: Touching a surface while resting or leaning against it.
against.exampleUsage: The ladder rests against the wall.

around.definition: On every side of something, or moving in a circle.
around.exampleUsage: The boxes stand around the table.

among.definition: In the middle of, or surrounded by, a group of things or people.
among.exampleUsage: The small box is among the larger boxes.

within.definition: Inside a place, area, or stated limit.
within.exampleUsage: The room is within the office building.

beyond.definition: Farther away than a stated place or boundary.
beyond.exampleUsage: The garden is beyond the rear door.

into.definition: Showing movement from outside to inside a place or thing.

out-of.definition: Moving from within a container, boundary, or enclosed area to a location beyond it.
out-of.exampleUsage: Omar takes a folder out of the drawer.

onto.definition: Showing movement to a position on a surface.
onto.exampleUsage: Omar puts the folder onto the desk.

off.definition: Away from or no longer touching a surface.
off.exampleUsage: Omar takes the cup off the desk.

through.definition: Moving into one side of something and out the other.

across.definition: From one side of an area to the other.

along.definition: Following the length or direction of something.

over.definition: Above or across the upper part of something.
over.exampleUsage: The cable runs over the door frame.

past.definition: Beyond a person, place, or point after moving by it.
past.exampleUsage: The trolley moves past the chair.

toward.definition: Moving in the direction of a place or goal.
toward.exampleUsage: The trolley moves toward the exit.

top.exampleUsage: The blank label is at the top of the folder.

bottom.definition: The lowest part of an object or area.
bottom.exampleUsage: The clip is at the bottom of the folder.

left.definition: The direction on the side of your left hand.
left.exampleUsage: The pen is on the left side of the desk.

right.definition: The direction on the side of your right hand.
right.exampleUsage: The notebook is on the right side of the desk.

center.definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region.
center.exampleUsage: The laptop is in the center of the desk.

middle.definition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region.
middle.exampleUsage: The laptop is in the middle of the desk.

corner.definition: A place where two sides, edges or walls meet.
corner.exampleUsage: The bin stands in the corner of the room.

edge.definition: The outside limit of an object or area or surface.
edge.exampleUsage: The ruler lies along the edge of the table.

side.definition: One part of an object or area away from its center.
side.exampleUsage: The chair is at the side of the table.

end.definition: The final part or limit of a thing.
end.exampleUsage: The box is at the end of the shelf.
